north_star: Help the operator reach the cheapest semantically valid next move with the least ritual necessary.

doctrine.summary: Loop First, Determinism Second, Generalize Last.

phase_authority.explore: agent primary, personas widen discovery, ontology advisory
phase_authority.plan: agent primary, personas challenge, ontology enforces contracts
phase_authority.execute: agent primary, personas and ontology boundary-only
phase_authority.reflect: agent primary, personas challenge proof, ontology checks consistency

doctrine.anti_ritual_rule: Do not add continuous execute-time supervision or extra workflows when existing surfaces can express the same signal.

anti_ritual_contract.summary: Anti-ritual warnings stay visible, but only explicit semantic/proof/integrity bases may hard-block.
anti_ritual_contract.mixed_enforcement_rule: Ritual drift is advisory unless the blocker is backed by semantic_block, integrity_or_poison, required_proof_gap, or planner_core_self_proof.
anti_ritual_contract.preferred_route: Prefer the lightest valid flow, or recover then return to the lightest valid flow when a poisoned lightweight plan is active.

hard_policies.summary: Only semantic risk, missing proof substance, and real integrity contradictions may hard-block planner progress.
Known wording and formatting variance must be normalized before any planner surface escalates severity.
Ontology and Prolog should challenge, constrain, and enrich reasoning without replacing open-ended judgment.
Prefer findings that reduce ambiguity or risk over ceremony that only proves the planner was used.

anti_goals: Ritual hard blocks caused only by heading wording, label drift, or stale failure history.
A second AI fixer layer that guesses at missing semantic content.
Ontology rules that substitute for product or implementation judgment.
Verbose traces or telemetry that add operator burden without clear learning value.
Continuous execute-time supervision that turns planner discipline into ritual.
success_signals: One deterministic script can explain the planner's north star, route, evidence mode, semantic blocks, repairable variances, and next best actions.
The shared planner surfaces expose anti_ritual status, drift ids, and a recommended action without inventing a separate ritual workflow.
Reasonable wording variants produce the same planner classification and gate outcome.
Simple CMS or static work routes lightweight when appropriate instead of being trapped in planner-core ceremony.
Planner-core and other semantic-risk work still surface strong proof obligations and real blockers.
Shared routing surfaces expose authority profile, audit posture, recommended path, and symmetry hunts without inventing extra planner commands.

responsibilities: Surface invariant violations and missing semantic obligations.
Expose the cheapest valid next move or recovery path for known planner states.
Classify repairable variance separately from semantic blockers.
non_goals: Replacing open-ended implementation planning or tradeoff reasoning.
Guessing at missing requirements or synthesizing evidence that does not exist.
